caption: The drawing depicts a stylized human figure standing on a pedestal. The figure has a light brown face with dark brown hair, and is shown with both hands pressed together in front of the chest. The figure is surrounded by a large halo made up of concentric circles in red and gray with blue rays and yellow dots radiating outward. The figure wears a long robe with green and red outer edges, and an interior pattern made of blue, red, yellow, and light green stripes with repeated blue, yellow, and red dotted motifs. The lower portion of the robe flares outward and rests on a circular, layered base colored in red, white, pink, and blue horizontal bands. At the base are stylized green leaves extending outward on either side. The pedestal beneath the figure is drawn as a tiered, zigzagged platform in light blue and gray with red outlines. The background is plain, off-white with no additional objects or designs.
title: Plate 34: Our Lady of Light: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico
